frames.description: Straight-on portrait view. Neutral and professional — best for showcasing UI content clearly.

frames.name: isometric-left
frames.description: A tilted, front-left perspective of a phone. The device leans backward, revealing the blank, front panel alongside the left-side edge with volume buttons, and the bottom ports.

frames.name: isometric-right
frames.description: A tilted, front-right perspective of a phone. The device leans backward, revealing the blank, front panel alongside the right-side edge with volume buttons, and the bottom ports.

frames.name: tilted-left

frames.name: tilted-right
frames.description: A tilted, front-right perspective of a phone. The device leans backward, revealing the blank, front panel alongside the right-side edge and bottom ports.

frames.name: angled-right
frames.description: A front-right angled perspective of a phone. The device is rotated slightly on its Y-axis to reveal the blank, front panel alongside the right-side edge and button.

frames.name: angled-left

frames.name: tilted-front
frames.description: A direct, front-facing perspective of a phone. The device is tilted slightly backward, revealing the full blank, front panel alongside the bottom edge and ports.
